Coverage includes appearances by Linsey Davis, Whit Johnson, Lara Spencer, and more.Watch the 2026 Oscars and Red Carpet free on DIRECTVThe ceremonyReturning for his second consecutive year as host is award-winning comedian Conan O’Brien, praised for his witty, respectful and effortlessly charming stage presence. This Oscars marks a historic milestone with the introduction of the Best Casting category—the first new competitive award since 2001. Leading the nominations is “Sinners,” which earned a record 16 nominations, surpassing classics like “Titanic.” Other frontrunners include “Hamnet,” “Marty Supreme,” “One Battle After Another,” “Frankenstein” and “Sentimental Value.” PerformancesMusic will be a highlight with two live performances: “Golden” from KPop Demon Hunters, performed by EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami; and “I Lied to You” from “Sinners,” featuring a powerhouse ensemble including Miles Caton, Raphael Saadiq, Misty Copeland, Buddy Guy, and others.
